caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a decorated band or cuff, possibly a beaded belt or bracelet, presented in three-quarter perspective. The object is primarily rendered with outlines and colored pencil or crayon on a beige background. The main section of the band features geometric patterns, including triangles and rectangles colored in shades of blue, green, yellow, pink, and brown. The design includes a large central rectilinear motif with a blue border and an inner X-shaped pattern in green and pink, surrounded by other geometric shapes and symmetrical decorations. The left end of the band has a visible loop or tie drawn in gray shading, suggesting how the object might be fastened. The band itself is outlined in gray, with a zigzag pattern in black along the top and bottom borders. The drawing is centered on a slightly darker rectangular patch that is mounted on a lighter cream-colored background.
title: Armband
